ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); record the driver's cancellation/arrival misreport for monitoring — no fraud signal, since no "I'm Here" was pressed and no arrival was logged.

rejected_claims.reason: No no-show fee basis existed: driver never tapped "I'm Here" [F4], platform never recorded arrival [F3], and GPS shows the driver never came within 200 m (closest 1685 m) [F1]. Also the trip was cancelled by the rider, so NS-1 does not apply.
Driver's out-of-chat statement "I was on my way when the rider cancelled" is a statement, not a system record, and does not establish arrival or any fee entitlement.
